issue.title: mapping-sheet: script omits original description when a reference is used for an object

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the issue, but the fix introduced a regression: tests/commands/test_mapping_sheet.py::test_command passed before the fix and fails after it. Check whether that test's expected output needs updating for the new "reference" rows or whether the fix broke existing mapping-sheet behaviour, and note that the reproduction was not confirmed as guarded by the fix.
